headline: One picture, 351 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 3 different files and attached to 351 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 351 separate works.

The 3 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 1 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.005 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 6ca2ed5a023a on 221 works, b4ea2c401c43 on 128 works, f200af99cd2c on 2 works.
The works are recorded as: Other (349), Contour Trench (2).
All 351 works report the same GPS point (31.38, 75.72).
